text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Here I go. Vajra Yaegaki Style: Magic 
Bullet Meteor Rain!!
(RUUUUMBLE!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAAA!!!! TAKE THIIIIIS!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Inari! You're on fire today! Nice 
receive!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet your boots I am! There's no way in 
hell we're gonna lose this event!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Um, I was a little curious about 
something...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Do you two have a special attachment to 
this sport? You both seem to be putting 
quite a lot of effort into it—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you wanna hear it? It's a tearjerker 
of a tale about me and Tama's own 
experience—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No good... No matter how hard I spike, I 
keep gettin' blocked...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Even when I try to jump and block her, 
she clears right over me without breaking 
a sweat..."

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Volleyball is all about height!! The one 
who reaches higher and commands the skies 
becomes the champion!

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Before you get crushed any further and 
shrink even more, shouldn't you make a 
substitution?

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrrgh...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...And while we got crushed in the 
neighborhood volleyball tournament like 
that, height doesn't matter when it comes 
to a receiving showdown!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If anything, our tight turns give us the 
edge! Let's do this, Inari! We're gonna 
set a smashing record in this event—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna shut up everyone who called us 
runts, all in one go!!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, Tama! We're gonna take the top 
spot in the U.A.F. and set off some 
massive fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Both of you...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Your unyielding spirit is truly 
admirable. Unworthy as I, Yaeno Muteki, 
may be, I shall accompany you both in your 
special training until the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks, Yaeno! And with that said, 
no holding back, Tama, let's go again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, let's do this, Inari! I'll show 
'em what this Little Tank is made of!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Ah, even so...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I can't possibly tell them this. The way 
the two of them were nimbly rushing around 
to receive the ball was——)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Even if they tore my mouth open, I would 
never, ever say that she looks as utterly 
adorable as a hamster—!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's up, Yaeno! Hurry up and pass 
the ball over!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Give it your all, no holding back and no 
pulling punches! I might be pint-sized, 
but my spirit's grand!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: Wha-!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, s-so c-cuuute!!!
